text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 10, 2024) for 28 Riverwood Parkway

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 10, 2024) for 28 Riverwood Parkway, Folder Number 24 175739 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 5, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
